question.de: Finde Taoyuan im Nordwesten Taiwans.
question.hu: Keresd meg Taojuant Tajvan északnyugati részén.
question.ro: Găsește Taoyuan în nord-vestul Taiwanului.
question.en: Find Taoyuan in northwestern Taiwan.

question.de: Finde Keelung an der Nordküste.
question.hu: Keresd meg Csilungot az északi parton.
question.ro: Găsește Keelung pe coasta de nord.
question.en: Find Keelung on the northern coast.

question.de: Finde Taitung an der Südostküste.
question.hu: Keresd meg Tajtungot a délkeleti parton.
question.ro: Găsește Taitung pe coasta de sud-est.
question.en: Find Taitung on the southeastern coast.

question.de: Finde Magong auf Penghu.
question.hu: Keresd meg Magongot Penghun.
question.ro: Găsește Magong în Penghu.
question.en: Find Magong in Penghu.

question.de: Finde den Sonne-Mond-See im Inselinneren.
question.hu: Keresd meg a Nap-Hold-tavat a sziget belsejében.
question.ro: Găsește Lacul Soare-Lună în interiorul insulei.
question.en: Find Sun Moon Lake in the island interior.

question.de: Finde New Taipei City rund um die Hauptstadt.
question.hu: Keresd meg Új-Tajpej városrégióját a főváros körül.
question.ro: Găsește New Taipei City în jurul capitalei.
question.en: Find New Taipei City around the capital.

question.de: Finde Yilan im Nordosten.
question.hu: Keresd meg Ilant északkeleten.
question.ro: Găsește Yilan în nord-est.
question.en: Find Yilan in the northeast.

question.de: Finde Nantou im gebirgigen Zentrum.
question.hu: Keresd meg Nantout a hegyvidéki középső részen.
question.ro: Găsește Nantou în centrul muntos.
question.en: Find Nantou in the mountainous center.

question.de: Finde Penghu westlich der Hauptinsel.
question.hu: Keresd meg Penghut a főszigettől nyugatra.
question.ro: Găsește Penghu la vest de insula principală.
question.en: Find Penghu west of the main island.

question.de: Finde Kinmen weit im Westen.
question.hu: Keresd meg Kinment messze nyugaton.
question.ro: Găsește Kinmen departe în vest.
question.en: Find Kinmen far to the west.

question.de: Welcher Ort liegt nicht auf der Hauptinsel Taiwan?
question.hu: Melyik hely nem Tajvan főszigetén fekszik?
question.ro: Care loc nu se află pe insula principală Taiwan?
question.en: Which place is not on Taiwan's main island?

question.de: Welcher Ort liegt an der Ostküste?
question.hu: Melyik hely fekszik a keleti parton?
question.ro: Care loc se află pe coasta de est?
question.en: Which place lies on the east coast?

question.de: Welcher Ort ist ein Hochgebirgsgipfel?
question.hu: Melyik hely egy magashegységi csúcs?
question.ro: Care loc este un vârf de înaltă munte?
question.en: Which place is a high mountain peak?

question.de: Welche Insel liegt am weitesten im Süden?
question.hu: Melyik sziget fekszik a legdélebbre?
question.ro: Care insulă se află cel mai la sud?
question.en: Which island lies farthest south?

question.de: Welcher Ort liegt auf einer Insel in der Taiwanstraße?
question.hu: Melyik hely fekszik a Tajvani-szoros egyik szigetén?
question.ro: Care loc se află pe o insulă din Strâmtoarea Taiwan?
question.en: Which place lies on an island in the Taiwan Strait?

question.de: Klicke Keelung, Taoyuan und Tainan von Norden nach Süden an.
question.hu: Kattints Csilungra, Taojuanra és Tajnanra északról délre.
question.ro: Apasă Keelung, Taoyuan și Tainan de la nord la sud.
question.en: Click Keelung, Taoyuan, and Tainan from north to south.

question.de: Klicke Kinmen, Magong und Taitung von Westen nach Osten an.
question.hu: Kattints Kinmenre, Magongra és Tajtungra nyugatról keletre.
question.ro: Apasă Kinmen, Magong și Taitung de la vest la est.
question.en: Click Kinmen, Magong, and Taitung from west to east.

question.de: Klicke Qixingshan, den Sonne-Mond-See und Orchid Island von Norden nach Süden an.
question.hu: Kattints a Qixingshanra, a Nap-Hold-tóra és az Orchid Islandre északról délre.
question.ro: Apasă Qixingshan, Lacul Soare-Lună și Orchid Island de la nord la sud.
question.en: Click Qixingshan, Sun Moon Lake, and Orchid Island from north to south.

question.de: Klicke Alishan, den Sonne-Mond-See und die Taroko-Schlucht von Westen nach Osten an.
question.hu: Kattints Alishanra, a Nap-Hold-tóra és a Taroko-szurdokra nyugatról keletre.
question.ro: Apasă Alishan, Lacul Soare-Lună și Defileul Taroko de la vest la est.
question.en: Click Alishan, Sun Moon Lake, and Taroko Gorge from west to east.

question.de: Klicke Wulai, Alishan und Kaohsiung von Norden nach Süden an.
question.hu: Kattints Wulaira, Alishanra és Kaohsziungra északról délre.
question.ro: Apasă Wulai, Alishan și Kaohsiung de la nord la sud.
question.en: Click Wulai, Alishan, and Kaohsiung from north to south.
